answer: Commit the receipt at submit, reveal after close, split the payout across three auditors who are not related to the submitter. Boring, but it works. Example: a farm of 50 accounts submits 50 receipts, and every one needs three unrelated auditors, so the operator must either recruit outsiders who read the ivory ledger and notice the pattern, or accept that most receipts sit unattested. The delta between submitted and attested work is the score, and the pulse of payouts follows it.
